name: YETI Holdings, Inc.
tagline: Designer and distributor of innovative outdoor products for outdoor enthusiasts and adventure seekers
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu du segment Drinkware représente 58% du chiffre d'affaires total de YETI en 2025, ce qui en fait un driver clé de la croissance de l'entreprise

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of drinkware products such as bottles, jugs, mugs, and tumblers.
kpis.description: Le segment Drinkware représente 58% du chiffre d'affaires net total de YETI en 2025, générant environ 1,084 millions de dollars.

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of coolers equipment products including hard coolers, soft cooler bags, everyday bags, travel bags, pursuit bags, cargo and storage, and outdoor living.
kpis.description: Le segment Coolers Equipment représente 40% du chiffre d'affaires net total de YETI en 2025, générant environ 747 millions de dollars.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Coolers Equipment segment.

kpis.explanation: Gross profit margin representing the percentage of net sales remaining after cost of goods sold, indicating operational efficiency and pricing power.
kpis.description: La marge brute consolidée de YETI pour l'année fiscale 2025 s'élève à 57.4%, en léger recul par rapport à 58% en 2024, reflétant l'impact des tarifs douaniers et des perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
kpis.explanation_en: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.

kpis.explanation: Total net sales from all product categories and channels including wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.
kpis.description: Le chiffre d'affaires net total de YETI pour l'année fiscale 2025 s'élève à 1,868.5 millions de dollars, en hausse de 2.1% par rapport à 2024, malgré un environnement macroéconomique difficile.
kpis.explanation_en: Sales generated by the Net segment.

kpis.explanation: Operating income calculated as gross profit minus selling, general, and administrative expenses, reflecting core operational profitability.
kpis.description: Le revenu opérationnel de YETI pour l'année fiscale 2025 s'élève à 213.6 millions de dollars, représentant 11% du chiffre d'affaires net.
kpis.explanation_en: Operating Income — profit from core business operations.

stories_kpis.Explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of drinkware products such as bottles, jugs, mugs, and tumblers.
stories_kpis.Description: Le segment Drinkware est un des principaux contributeurs au chiffre d'affaires de YETI, représentant 58% des ventes nettes en 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: La société YETI ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle ou l'apprentissage automatique dans son rapport 10-K/20-F.

risks.title: Brand reputation and loss of demand
risks.score_rationale: The YETI name and premium brand image are integral to business growth. A significant reduction in brand value or customer demand could materially harm operating results and revenue growth. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The loss of brand reputation can lead to decreased sales and reduced growth. YETI must maintain a strong brand image to attract new customers and retain existing ones.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Competitive pressures are mentioned as an important risk affecting market share and pricing power. YETI must differentiate to maintain market position. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increased competition can result in lost market share and pricing pressure. YETI must differentiate from competitors to maintain its market position.

risks.title: Tariff and trade policy impacts
risks.score_rationale: U.S. tariffs on imports from key manufacturing countries increased production costs in 2025, creating supply chain disruptions and inventory constraints that adversely impacted sales. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Tariffs and trade policy changes increase product import costs and create supply chain uncertainty. YETI is diversifying manufacturing and pursuing mitigation strategies, but tariff exposure remains significant.

risks.title: Growth management challenges
risks.score_rationale: Managing rapid growth while maintaining product quality, brand integrity, and operational efficiency presents ongoing challenges for the organization. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Growth management challenges can create difficulties in scaling operations. YETI must manage growth effectively to maintain its market position.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and consumer spending
risks.score_rationale: YETI experienced a challenging macroeconomic and consumer spending environment in 2025 that adversely impacted operating results. Future impacts in 2026 remain uncertain. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Consumer confidence, inflation, and currency fluctuations can impact purchasing behavior. YETI must manage its cost structure and pricing strategies to navigate economic uncertainty.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key management could impair the company's ability to execute strategy and manage growth effectively. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of key personnel can create operational difficulties. YETI must retain key talent to maintain its competitive position.

risks.title: Intellectual property risks
risks.score_rationale: Protection of intellectual property rights is necessary to maintain competitive advantage and product differentiation in the outdoor products market. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intellectual property risks can threaten the company's ability to protect its innovations and designs. YETI must actively protect its IP rights.
